name: token-exchange
description: RFC 8693 token exchange, translated from token-exchange-demo. Set server to the IdP issuer URL, api_key for dynamic client registration, and redirect_uri to this RunWay origin plus /scenario-auth/callback. Run Tests pauses so you can sign in with a device code or the authorization code flow.

limitations: The sign-in step runs in the web UI. The CLI stops there.
